title: AML Memory Collection Definition
description: Compiled JSON payload for an AML memory collection definition (.collection.md). Validates that the compiled output conforms to the AML v1.2 specification.

spec_version.title: Spec Version
spec_version.description: AML format version. Must equal a platform-approved version string.

collection_id.title: Collection ID
collection_id.description: Stable, immutable identifier for this collection. Lowercase kebab-case. Immutable once referenced by any published agent definition.

version.title: Version
version.description: Semantic version of this collection definition.

status.title: Status
status.description: Lifecycle state. draft=not usable in production; active=usable; deprecated=usable but lint warning; disabled=hard compile error on reference.

meta.title: Metadata
meta.description: Descriptive metadata for this memory collection.

name.title: Name
name.description: Human-readable display name for this collection.

description.title: Description
description.description: Short description of what this collection stores and how agents should use it.

owner.title: Owner
owner.description: Team or individual responsible for maintaining this collection.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Searchable labels for discovery and filtering.

last_updated.title: Last Updated
last_updated.description: ISO 8601 date of the last update to this collection definition.

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: Memory scope configuration. Determines who shares this collection and for how long.

lifetime.title: Lifetime
lifetime.description: session=current conversation only; project=all sessions under the same project; user=all sessions across all projects for the same user.

backend.title: Backend
backend.description: Storage configuration. Exactly one 'type' sub-key must match the backend type. backend.type is constrained by scope.lifetime: session scopes must use valkey or s3; project and user scopes must use agentcore_memory or custom.

writeback.title: Writeback
writeback.description: Controls whether the agent is permitted to write back to this collection after a run. For agentcore_memory backends, writeback behavior (extraction strategy, summarization) is governed by the AgentCore Memory resource configuration, not by AML. For custom backends, the endpoint owns its own extraction and persistence logic.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: If true, agents may declare this collection under write_collections. If false, any agent declaring this collection as writable is a hard validation error.

documentation.title: Documentation
documentation.description: Compiled from the Markdown body of the .collection.md file. Sections are optional but validated when present.

purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.description: Compiled from the optional '# Purpose' section. Why this collection exists and how agents are expected to use it.

content_coverage.title: Content Coverage
content_coverage.description: Compiled from the optional '# Content coverage' section. What kinds of facts or data this collection stores.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Compiled from the optional '# Notes' section. Miscellaneous guidance for authors and reviewers.

aml_id.title: AML ID
aml_id.description: Stable, immutable AML identifier. Lowercase kebab-case or snake_case. Must match ^[a-z0-9_-]{3,64}$.

retrieval_config_entry.title: Retrieval Config Entry
retrieval_config_entry.description: Retrieval parameters for a single AgentCore memory namespace.

top_k.title: Top K
top_k.description: Number of top-scoring records to return from semantic search. Default: 10.

relevance_score.title: Relevance Score
relevance_score.description: Minimum relevance threshold for filtering results (0.0–1.0). Records below this score are excluded. Default: 0.2.

backend_agentcore_memory.title: Backend Agentcore Memory
backend_agentcore_memory.description: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Memory backend. The AgentCore Memory resource (including its strategies and namespaces) is provisioned separately from agent deployment via the AWS Console, CLI, or a setup script. AML only references the resource by ID and configures retrieval parameters.

memory_id_secret.title: Memory ID Secret
memory_id_secret.description: Secrets manager path resolving to the AgentCore Memory resource ID. Never hardcode the resource ID directly.

region.title: Region
region.description: AWS region where the AgentCore Memory resource is deployed.

retrieval_config.title: Retrieval Config
retrieval_config.description: Maps namespace patterns to retrieval parameters. Keys are namespace strings (e.g. /preferences/{actorId}, /context/{projectId}) that must match the namespaces configured on the AgentCore Memory resource. {actorId}, {projectId}, and {sessionId} placeholders are substituted automatically by the runtime. Omit to use the AgentCore resource defaults.

batch_size.title: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Number of messages to buffer locally before flushing to AgentCore Memory. Default 1 sends each message immediately. Higher values reduce API call volume for high-throughput agents.

endpoint_secret.title: Endpoint Secret
endpoint_secret.description: Name of the environment variable containing the Valkey endpoint URL.

port.title: Port
port.description: Valkey port. Defaults to 6379 if omitted.

key_prefix.title: Key Prefix
key_prefix.description: Optional key prefix to namespace records in Valkey.

ttl_seconds.title: TTL Seconds
ttl_seconds.description: Time-to-live in seconds for stored records. Records expire after this duration.

backend_s3.title: Backend S3
backend_s3.description: Amazon S3 session snapshot backend. Stores session state as JSON objects in an S3 bucket. Appropriate for session-scoped collections where durability and cost are the priority over sub-millisecond restore latency. Only valid for scope.lifetime: session.

bucket_secret.title: Bucket Secret
bucket_secret.description: Secrets manager path resolving to the S3 bucket name. Never hardcode the bucket name directly.

region.title: Region
region.description: AWS region where the S3 bucket is located.

prefix.title: Prefix
prefix.description: Optional S3 key prefix. Omit for no prefix. The runtime stores snapshots under <prefix>/<session_id>/agent/<agent_id>/snapshots/.

ttl_days.title: TTL Days
ttl_days.description: Optional S3 object lifecycle TTL in days. The runtime applies this as an object expiry rule at write time.

backend_custom.title: Backend Custom
backend_custom.description: Custom backend that delegates all memory management to an external endpoint. The endpoint must implement the Strands SnapshotStorage interface. Transport is either rest-api or lambda, using the same credentials model as tools and guardrails.

transport.title: Transport
transport.description: Transport configuration. Either rest-api or lambda. Uses the same credentials model as tool and guardrail transports.

credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.description: Authentication configuration for an external transport. scheme selects the auth method; source specifies how the runtime resolves the secret value.

source.title: Source
source.description: How the runtime resolves the credential value. Not required when scheme is iam-role.

secret_id.title: Secret ID
secret_id.description: AWS Secrets Manager secret ID. Required when source is aws_secrets_manager.

name.title: Name
name.description: Environment variable name. Required when source is env.

header.title: Header
header.description: HTTP header name to send the credential in. Required when scheme is api-key.

token_url.title: Token URL
token_url.description: OAuth2 token endpoint URL. Required when scheme is oauth2.

client_id.title: Client ID
client_id.description: OAuth2 client ID. Required when scheme is oauth2.

client_secret.title: Client Secret
client_secret.description: Secrets manager path resolving to the OAuth2 client secret. Required when scheme is oauth2.

max_attempts.title: Max Attempts
max_attempts.description: Maximum number of attempts including the first. Set to 1 to disable retries.

on_status.title: On Status
on_status.description: HTTP status codes that trigger a retry.

backoff_ms.title: Backoff Ms
backoff_ms.description: Initial backoff in milliseconds between retry attempts.

transport_rest_api.title: Transport Rest Api
transport_rest_api.description: HTTP/REST transport. The runtime calls different paths per SnapshotStorage operation.

base_url.title: Base URL
base_url.description: Base URL of the memory service. No trailing slash.

transport_lambda.title: Transport Lambda
transport_lambda.description: AWS Lambda transport. The runtime passes an operation field in the payload to distinguish SnapshotStorage calls.

function_arn.title: Function ARN
function_arn.description: Fully qualified ARN of the Lambda function implementing the SnapshotStorage interface.

invocation_type.title: Invocation Type
invocation_type.description: Lambda invocation type. Must be RequestResponse for memory operations.
